title: The seven continents and five oceans
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: The continents and oceans are the first map most children learn: the big pieces of land and the big bodies of water. Knowing them in order of size gives a sense of scale, and every later map lesson builds on it.

How to hold it: Twelve names is two small chunks: seven continents and five oceans. Learn each in order of size, biggest first, with a first-letter sentence: All Animals Need Some Antarctic Exercise Always, for Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, Australia; and Polar Animals Imagine Snowy Adventures, for Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, Arctic. Then point to each one on a globe or a map as you say it: picture plus words. Recall with the map covered, and come back on day 1, 3, 7 and 21.
